decision: Review the app for real speed and security defects, then ship a small verified stack to main
why: About 23k lines of app Swift and 4.6k of tests. No Xcode on this Linux VM. Security and data paths are high rigor. Taste refactors of SwiftDataArchiveBridge are out.

decision: Ship four units: shared HTTP URL parse, predicate fetches, Settings counts, cover keep-last-image. Skip rewriting the 1782-line archive bridge.
why: The import path already requires http or https plus a host. Fetch and persist did not. Full-table MediaValue fetches and Settings @Query are measured in code, not guessed.

decision: Added RemoteHTTPURL and closed fetch plus persist boundaries that accepted file URLs
why: Import already required http or https with a host. Artwork, RSS, HTTPClient, and the item editor did not. A restored file cover URL would have been fetched.
result: implemented, tests added, Xcode not available on this VM

decision: Media Value lookups use predicates. Settings and Search no longer load the whole store for counts or local matches.
why: validateItem and assignments fetched every row. Settings @Query loaded every item and list to count trash and archive.

decision: CoverArtworkView keeps the last image while the same asset reloads at a new size
why: The load task cleared image on every GeometryReader tick, which flashes covers during layout.

decision: Did not rewrite SwiftDataArchiveBridge or add Keychain accessibility on update
why: Inserts already use AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly. The archive bridge is 1782 lines and had no defect in this pass. Laziness protocol.

decision: Shared PodcastFeedPrivacy.isSensitive; manual save Keychains token or userinfo feeds; existing non-HTTP feeds can still toggle privacy
why: Import already classified these as private. Manual save wrote them to SwiftData. classify() Keychains every non-Apple feed, so it cannot be reused. Bugbot showed a grandfathered file feed skipped reconcile.
result: implemented, tests added, Xcode not available on this VM

decision: setTitle now writes sortTitle; mergeDetails keeps a custom sort key if it no longer matches the search title
why: Library and Lists sort by sortTitle. Rename left items under the old key.
result: implemented, tests added, Xcode not available on this VM

decision: Recently Deleted purge and permanent delete take the restore gate; trash and archive queries use predicates
why: A purge save mid replace-all restore can commit a half-wiped graph. Trash views loaded every item.
result: implemented, Xcode not available on this VM

decision: Home body partitions rails once and passes the slices into the sections
why: overdue, active, and planned each called partition and faulted reminders.
result: implemented, Xcode not available on this VM
